<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>Detects the specific 4-bit binary sequence 1001.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal to synchronize the detector.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">Active-low reset signal to initialize the state machine.</input>
        <input id="data_in">1-bit binary input signal to feed the bitstream for sequence detection.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">1-bit output signal that is set high when the specific sequence is detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>IDL</parameter>
        <parameter>S1</parameter>
        <parameter>S2</parameter>
        <parameter>S3</parameter>
        <parameter>S4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state">State register to hold the current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state">Next state register to hold the next state of the FSM.</reg>
        <wire id="detected_sequence">Wire to indicate if the sequence has been detected.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
            if (!reset_n) begin
                current_state <= IDL;
                sequence_detected <= 0;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
                if (next_state == S4) begin
                    sequence_detected <= 1;
                end else begin
                    sequence_detected <= 0;
                end
            end
        end

        // Next state logic
        always @(*) begin
            case (current_state)
                IDL: begin
                    if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDL;
                    end
                end
                S1: begin
                    if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S2;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDL;
                    end
                end
                S2: begin
                    if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S3;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDL;
                    end
                end
                S3: begin
                    if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S4;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDL;
                    end
                end
                S4: begin
                    next_state = IDL;
                end
                default: begin
                    next_state = IDL;
                end
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
